paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens.
model_annotation: The line plot compares the Macro-F1 scores (%) of two models—MATTER (ours) and w/o material information—across varying numbers of tokens during training. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," ranges from 0.6 to 1.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, representing the number of tokens used in the tokenization process. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," spans from 48 to 58, with gridlines at every 2 percentage points. The MATTER (ours) model is represented by a red line with circular markers and a light red shaded area indicating variance; it starts at approximately 55.1% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of 57.8% at 1.0 token, then declines to around 50.8% at 1.5 tokens. The w/o material information model is shown with a purple line and circular markers, starting at 52.5% at 0.6 tokens, peaking at 54.1% at 0.7 tokens, and generally decreasing to 47.9% at 1.5 tokens. The shaded regions around each line suggest variability in performance, with the MATTER model showing higher scores overall except at the highest token count, where its performance drops sharply.
